 Articles : Como are looking for confirmation. They'll be in Turin with Paz and Ramon. A win against the Granata could secure third place. 
 Facebook X WhatsApp Print At 12:30, Venezia will be at the Sinigaglia stadium, and Como will need to win to stay at the top. There are numerous injuries in the Azzurri camp, the only positive note being Liberali's recovery. "Mattia has worked well this week," says Fabregas. "He's had two consecutive training sessions and is pain-free." The coach also has to take into account Wednesday's match against Lens, and, as in Turin, there will likely be many substitutions during the match. There are several unknowns, Douvikas needs a breather, but there are no alternatives: "We don't know Kean's exact recovery time," continues Fabregas. "Before he was acquired, he underwent thorough medical checks, more than we do with other players, and they didn't detect any problems with his tibia, where he had already suffered an injury. With Diao, we have more certainty; he could return against Inter next week."
 Leaving injuries aside, we need to focus on Venezia. "Our opponents aren't showing their points," Fabregas continues. "They've made many top teams like Inter and Napoli suffer. We need to be united and make the most of our squad. The game is a lot and at a faster pace than when I was on the pitch. There are numerous injuries, and this is an additional task for the coach and his staff, and this applies not just to us but to all the teams playing in the cups. However, we're only on matchday ten; Napoli and Juventus are behind, and as time goes on, they too will find the right balance. Congratulations to Lazio, who are surprising everyone, but not me. I was already saying last year that they were a great team; with a few transfer window adjustments, they've become a great team. This shows that to judge football, it's not enough to look at the immediate results but at the work done over time.
 (4-2-3-1): Butez; Smolcic, Kabawala, Kempf, Valle; Milla, Da Cunha; Liberali, Paz, Caqueret; Douvikas. Coach: Fabregas
